name: ClickHouse Log Analysis
description: Generate a ClickHouse SQL query for a service, fetch logs from ClickHouse, and produce a root-cause analysis.
instructions: Composed skill: runs clickhouse_sql_generation then fetch_and_analyze. Behavior is defined by those steps and their child skills; this field is required by the Skill API for all skills.

steps.objective: Generate a ClickHouse SQL query scoped to the target service using the provided labels and time window.
Fetch logs from ClickHouse using the generated SQL query and produce a root-cause analysis.

start_time.description: ISO 8601 start of the time window (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

end_time.description: ISO 8601 end of the time window (e.g. 2024-01-01T01:00:00Z)

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to fetch (default 100)
